Rank 2 Ki Technique

  • Ki Cost: Special
  • Prerequisites: None
  • Casting Time: 1 Action
  • Range: 45 Feet
  • Chargeable?: Yes
  • Duration: Instantaneous
  • Type: Blast

Make a massive sweeping blade-like energy attack. Roll a Blast Attack Roll dealing Xd6 Ki Damage on a hit, where X is for how many sets of 5 Ki you expend during the casting of this Technique.

The maximum Damage Dice Amount, before charging is calculated, can not exceed your total Character Level.
